body:
We now have bounded native Safari evidence for the first-session BASIC route: discovery, editing, keyboard run/exit, deliberate errors, repair, reset, and saving/reopening an edited greeting. The report retains the actual downloaded tape, exact observed output and configuration limits.

VoiceOver was skipped at the user’s request; physical touch remains untested. Native accessibility-tree inspection does not establish screen-reader usability or learner effectiveness. The general player’s unchanged lesson filename after loading the saved tape is recorded as a follow-up candidate, not a reproduced blocker. No website change is proposed.

Validation: eight source hashes checked with a deliberately wrong hash rejected; 85 local links checked; retained tape has two valid checksum blocks; Vale and git diff --check pass. Runtime observations are manual native Safari checks, not automated assertions.

Partial evidence for code198x/website#749 and stevehill1981/198x#124; neither issue is closed.
title: Record native Safari first-session operation and tape recovery
